about: Winnipeg is Manitoba’s capital, at the confluence of the Red and Assiniboine rivers on the Prairies. It is the province’s main city and a historic railway, grain, and cultural centre. The Forks sits at the core, with distinct districts such as the Exchange and francophone St. Boniface. About 750,000 people live in the city.
seoSummary: Manitoba’s capital at The Forks, a Prairie cultural and transport hub.
